name: SREBP-regulated cholesterol and sterol homeostasis
rationale: All members concern cellular cholesterol/sterol balance (synthesis, efflux, uptake, transport); unlike the LXR/efflux and LDL-receptor confusables, the theme carries SREBP-driven gene activation and biosynthesis regulation.

name: Stromal fibroblast matrix with complement and myeloid chemotaxis
rationale: Members describe fibroblast/stromal matrix, adhesion and complement-bearing secretory programmes; the theme adds macrophage and mast cell chemotaxis and TGF-beta1 production that the KRAS/fibroblast-proliferation and endothelial confusables lack.

core: Cytosolic dsRNA sensing to type I interferon
name: Cytosolic dsRNA sensing to type I interferon, with negative regulators
rationale: Members cover RIG-I/MDA5 and related nucleic-acid sensing that induces IRF3/IRF7-driven type I interferon; unlike confusables it includes negative regulation of RIG-I and antiviral defense rather than ISG effector or cGAS/STING arms.

qualifier: leukotriene synthesis and G protein-coupled receptors
name: Leukotriene synthesis and eicosanoid G protein-coupled receptor signaling
rationale: Members concern inflammatory lipid mediators (leukotrienes, prostanoids, PAF) and their GPCRs; the theme has leukotriene biosynthesis and receptor clusters, lacking the COX/prostaglandin synthesis, lipoxin and catabolic arms of confusables.

name: Neuronal Ig-superfamily adhesion in nodal assembly and dendrite self-avoidance
rationale: All members are neuronal adhesion-molecule interactions; the theme combines L1/neurofascin/NrCAM ankyrin-anchored sodium channel clustering at nodes with DSCAM/SDK/nectin dendrite self-avoidance, each half separating it from different confusables.

qualifier: L1/NCAM and ephrin signaling with neuron remodeling
name: L1/NCAM and ephrin signaling in axon fasciculation and neuron remodeling
rationale: Members are L1, CHL1, NCAM1 and ephrin-mediated repulsion, fasciculation and pruning; NCAM1/L1 and synapse pruning/remodeling distinguish it from the netrin, semaphorin and DSCAM confusables.

core: Antigen-presenting cell and T cell surface signatures
name: Dendritic cell-T cell surface costimulation and dendritic cell differentiation
rationale: Members are DC, T and plasma cell surface signatures plus regulation of T cell costimulation and DC differentiation/activation, lacking the MHC presentation, monocyte/CD1 and NK cytotoxicity content of confusables.

name: p53-driven intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis via BCL-2 family and apoptosome
rationale: All members concern mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization by BH3-only/BAX/BAK, cytochrome c release, apoptosome/SMAC and p53 regulation of these genes, unlike the execution-phase, p53 cell-cycle and senescence confusables.

name: ISG15 and interferon-stimulated effectors restricting viral life cycle
rationale: Members are type I interferon response signatures and ISG effector functions (ISG15 conjugation, suppression of viral replication, entry and release), distinguishing them from confusables built on upstream RIG-I/TBK1 sensing.

name: Satellite cell maintenance restraining skeletal muscle differentiation
rationale: All members concern holding muscle development in check via satellite cell maintenance and inhibition of their differentiation, whereas confusables concern myoblast fusion, migration, proliferation and atrophy.

name: Mast cell degranulation control and differentiation
rationale: All members are mast cell activation, degranulation, histamine release and differentiation, lacking the FcεRI signaling cascade and eosinophil/Th2 content of confusables.

qualifier: IL-12/23, IL-10 and IL-15/21 with NK development
name: IL-12/23, IL-10 and IL-15/21 cytokine signaling with NK development
rationale: Members are IL-12, IL-23, IL-10, IL-15 and IL-21 signaling plus NK cell differentiation/proliferation; IL-10/IL-12/IL-23 separate it from IL-2/IL-7 and interferon confusables, and IL-15/IL-21/NK from the IL-27/IL-35 confusable.

name: Extracellular matrix elastic fiber and collagen fibril assembly
rationale: Members are structural ECM modules and elastic fiber/collagen fibril organization, lacking the integrin/fibronectin, collagen biosynthesis/degradation and immune-matrix content of confusables.

name: Thymocyte proliferation, survival and selection in T cell development
rationale: All members regulate thymocyte proliferation, apoptosis, selection and differentiation (including gamma-delta), whereas confusables concern bone marrow and hematopoietic progenitor homeostasis.

name: NAD(P) salvage and nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion
rationale: Most members concern nicotinate/NAD(P) metabolism and nucleoside mono/di/triphosphate kinase interconversion; the NAD arm separates it from creatine/ATP-transport confusables and the nucleotide-kinase arm from the coenzyme A confusable.

qualifier: SLC4/SLC26 anion exchange, CFTR and aquaporins
name: Epithelial anion exchange and aquaporin water transport
rationale: Members cover bicarbonate, chloride, iodide, sulfate and oxalate transport by SLC4/SLC26/CFTR and water movement by aquaporins and paracellular/gap junction routes, unlike cation-chloride, organic-anion or pH-regulation confusables.

name: Axon regeneration after injury with p75NTR growth-control signaling
rationale: Members concern regeneration and sprouting of injured axons and the neurotrophin receptor axonal growth stimulation/inhibition (RhoA, ceramide) signaling, which the collateral-sprouting, semaphorin and myelination confusables lack.

qualifier: vesicle recycling and postsynaptic receptor internalization
name: Clathrin-mediated synaptic vesicle recycling and postsynaptic receptor endocytosis
rationale: Members are clathrin coat dynamics, synaptic vesicle endocytosis/recycling and postsynaptic receptor internalization, lacking the presynaptic cytoskeleton/release and receptor delivery content of confusables.

qualifier: stress and fear behavior with opioid receptors
name: Neuropeptide and opioid signaling in stress and fear behavior
rationale: Members concern neuropeptide/opioid GPCR signaling and dense-core vesicle release tied to CRH, corticosterone, fear, immobilization stress and ethanol responses, unlike sleep/orexin and mating-behavior confusables.

core: Regional central nervous system neuron differentiation
name: Regional brain and retinal neuron differentiation
rationale: Members are neuron/glia differentiation and patterning in forebrain, thalamus, midbrain, cerebellum and pituitary plus retinal amacrine/photoreceptor differentiation, which the progenitor-division, cortical-migration and spinal confusables lack.

Members span unrelated housekeeping modules (mitochondrial respiration/translation, cytosolic ribosome assembly, centrosomal mitosis, polycomb chromatin, ubiquitination, RB1/BCL2L1 survival, Pol II initiation) with no single biological theme true of all.

name: tRNA charging and anticodon modification for translational fidelity
rationale: Members are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation plus wobble/t6A anticodon modifications serving translational fidelity, which the wybutosine, pseudouridine/methylation and mitochondrial translation confusables lack.

qualifier: small GTPase prenylation and autophagy-linked delipidation
name: Small GTPase prenylation and autophagy-linked protein lipidation
rationale: Members concern lipid modification of proteins, chiefly RAS/RAB geranylgeranylation and processing, plus delipidation and autophagy-related processes, rather than the palmitoylation, Wnt and Hedgehog lipidation of confusables.

name: Monocyte and resting dendritic cell surface receptor signatures
rationale: All members are monocyte and dendritic cell surface/receptor signatures; the monocyte content separates it from T-cell/activated-DC confusables and the absence of CD1/antigen presentation from the monocyte-differentiation confusable.

name: Phospholipase C-gamma cascade downstream of FGF receptors
rationale: All three members are the PLC-gamma branch of FGFR1/3/4 signaling, distinguishing it from confusables built on PI3K, SHC and FRS2 branches or ligand binding.
